name: anti-slop
description: Keeps the UI and prose the agent writes from reading as AI slop.

interface.shortDescription: UI and text that do not read as AI-generated.
interface.longDescription: Two skills. anti-slop-ui keeps generated or restyled interfaces free of the common tells of AI slop — gradients everywhere, rainbow palettes, meaningless pulsing badges, fingernail-striped cards, emoji icons, default fonts, uppercase labels, scroll effects, missing states, and landing-page hype. anti-slop-text does the same for prose — invented details, inflated significance, promotional tone, contrast formulas, AI vocabulary, chat residue, and restating conclusions. Each reviews its output against a catalog of tells before it ships.
defaultPrompt: Restyle this page and check it for AI-slop tells.
Rewrite this README so it doesn't read as AI-generated.
